title: LSTM, leak-free walk-forward
hypothesis: The v36 LSTM lift survives when the LSTM is trained walk-forward.
question: With the LSTM retrained only on data before each anchor date, is there still a lift?
prior: If the lift was real it should survive leak-free training.
method: Walk-forward LSTM training, seed ensemble, same champion meta model and gate.
verdict_reason: Leak-free, the encoder scored 1.215 (below the 1.226 champion), the vol forecaster 1.225 and both together 1.222. AUC moved by at most 0.008, inside cross-validation noise.
lessons: A lift that disappears under walk-forward training was look-ahead.
row_note: best leak-free variant; champion without LSTM 1.226
footer: Research code is private; methods summarised below.
